changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE kyc_documents ADD COLUMN document_number VARCHAR(60) NULL, ADD COLUMN issue_date DATE NULL, ADD COLUMN expiry_date DATE NULL, ADD COLUMN expiry_notified_at DATETIME NULL, ADD COLUMN ocr_run_id VARCHAR(40) NULL, ADD COLUMN ocr_model_version VARCHAR(60) NULL, ADD COLUMN ocr_confidence DECIMAL(3,2) NULL, ADD COLUMN validation_status VARCHAR(20) NULL, ADD COLUMN replaced_by_document_id BIGINT NULL, ADD COLUMN address_proof_type VARCHAR(40) NULL, ADD COLUMN uses_aadhaar_for_address TINYINT(1) NULL

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kyc_document_fields ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, kyc_document_id BIGINT NOT NULL, field_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, field_value TEXT NULL, confidence DECIMAL(3,2) NULL, page INT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_kdf_document_id (kyc_document_id), CONSTRAINT fk_kdf_kyc_document FOREIGN KEY (kyc_document_id) REFERENCES kyc_documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

changeSet.author: facilon
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kyc_document_discrepancies ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, kyc_document_id BIGINT NOT NULL, canonical_source VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, field_name VARCHAR(100) NULL, expected_value TEXT NULL, observed_value TEXT NULL, severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_kdd_document_id (kyc_document_id), CONSTRAINT fk_kdd_kyc_document FOREIGN KEY (kyc_document_id) REFERENCES kyc_documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE kyc_documents ADD COLUMN confirmed_at DATETIME NULL

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kyc_profile_import_audit ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, investor_unique_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, source_document_id BIGINT NOT NULL, source_document_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, target_field VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, old_value TEXT NULL, new_value TEXT NULL, imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_kpia_investor (investor_unique_id), INDEX idx_kpia_source_doc (source_document_id) )
